items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Happy Shilling's band, George Shilling, his father.

ctx.x: Were you playing on those boats?

No, they usually used colored bands. They had some white bands on it. I can't remember the names, I don't know. I can reach you, I can go get my book and I can tell you right now, with all the different bands, Happy Shilling's band, George Shilling, his father. Yeah. And there was another one, Bob Aguilera used to play on those bands, the pillar with one leg. I told you when I did the, I was in charge of redoing the Musicians Union over when we renewed it, when we rejuvenated it. We went up in the attic and found…
Give it to the Jazz Museum.
